problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate shipments from a network of distribution centers to a series of retail outlets in order to minimize overall freight expense.

The inventory available at each distribution center (set C) is as follows:
*C1 has 155 units in stock.
*C2 has 181 units.
*C3 has 86 units.
*C4 has 91 units.
*C5 has 97 units.
*C6 has 106 units.
*C7 has 114 units.
*C8 has 99 units.
*C9 has 79 units.
*C10 has 96 units.

The required fulfillment at each retail outlet (set R) is detailed below:
*R1 requires 111 units.
*R2 requires 11 units.
*R3 requires 146 units.
*R4 requires 192 units.
*R5 requires 106 units.
*R6 requires 125 units.
*R7 requires 14 units.
*R8 requires 130 units.
*R9 requires 48 units.
*R10 requires 38 units.

The per-unit freight cost from each distribution center to each retail outlet is provided in the table:

| From / To | R1 | R2 | R3 | R4 | R5 | R6 | R7 | R8 | R9 | R10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | 19 | 16 | 11 | 12 | 5 | 8 | 4 | 10 | 20 | 3 |
| C2 | 7 | 11 | 16 | 15 | 11 | 20 | 10 | 19 | 5 | 19 |
| C3 | 19 | 12 | 11 | 14 | 6 | 1 | 11 | 8 | 8 | 14 |
| C4 | 9 | 12 | 5 | 11 | 16 | 15 | 15 | 12 | 10 | 16 |
| C5 | 18 | 4 | 6 | 20 | 3 | 9 | 5 | 18 | 7 | 9 |
| C6 | 3 | 3 | 1 | 17 | 1 | 19 | 19 | 13 | 19 | 7 |
| C7 | 2 | 18 | 9 | 18 | 18 | 16 | 5 | 12 | 13 | 8 |
| C8 | 19 | 10 | 5 | 15 | 17 | 17 | 3 | 13 | 12 | 17 |
| C9 | 1 | 8 | 20 | 6 | 17 | 5 | 15 | 6 | 6 | 19 |
| C10 | 19 | 5 | 16 | 12 | 2 | 8 | 16 | 8 | 3 | 9 |

Determine the optimal shipment quantities to achieve the lowest possible total freight cost.
